title: HSWall 솔로 #076 · 커브드바스트 · Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay · 나무 판자 벽 직접 고정
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in an old timber dungeon with a wall of thick rough dark oak planks behind her, a low beamed wooden ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the wall, old iron tools hanging on the wall, a worn plank floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Japanese woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, a faintly overwhelmed look, her eyes damp and her breath caught in slightly parted lips, bright golden-blonde hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay — a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay, wide gold-and-silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric star inlay filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The paint has worn thin in broad patches over her upper back, hips and calves and chipped off in small flakes at her wrists and ankles, the living skin showing through the faded pattern. Soot smudges her brow, upper lip and cheeks, sweat runs in clean tracks through the grime on her face, black streaks cross her arms and legs, and her bare feet are caked with soot and grime.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring fixed directly onto a heavy iron plate bolted flat to the plank wall high above her head on its own side, a little wider apart than her shoulders, the cuffs sitting snug against the plate, her arms stretched straight up. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring fixed directly onto a heavy iron plate bolted flat to the plank wall just above the floor on its own side, the cuffs sitting snug against the plate, her feet shoulder-width apart.

Pose: standing with her back pressed flat against the plank wall, facing the camera, her arms stretched straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, her bare feet shoulder-width apart flat on the floor, her head tipped slightly forward, her whole body sagging with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the floor, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
